scope: Local source inspection and synthetic selector contract tests only; no real fitting, prediction, attribution, HPC access or W&B mutation.

software_tests.scope: Synthetic selector branch and input-immutability behavior, not group-coverage validity or scientific efficacy.

historical_hash_check_scope: Existing local files compared with the saved independent arithmetic registry; not a fresh remote/archive/W&B check or a new aggregate recomputation.
unresolved_gates: Training lineage and four disjoint increment-available decision/evaluation partitions
Capture-group identities and sufficient independent-group support for the actual simultaneous bounds
Bound old/new native score exports faithful to the selected dataset and scoring call boundaries
Real repeated method-conditioned attribution arrays and faithful-target evidence
Dataset, development transition, primary explainer, thresholds, resource ceilings and all-arm policy registration
Independent execution review and any required user confirmation before real computation
claim_boundaries: Explanation change without measured performance harm remains audit-only.
Calibration is an action primitive, not the claimed novelty.
Old explanation validity and human-facing usefulness are not established by a predictive correction.
One before/after correction is not a complete forgetting trajectory.
Row-identity proxies are not independent capture groups.
